explanation: Job 1 corrupts the provenance handoff by setting evidence_sources.record_id to the source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id. Job 2 then receives evidence_sources keyed as s01..s08 while needs are keyed as n06-r01..n06-r08, so prioritize cannot match provenance ranks and all observed upstream_rank values become 0.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources has record_id values s01 through s08, while Job 2 input needs has record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks up coverage.record_id; the observed priorities all show upstream_rank: 0.
